decision: Advance P184 from 98% to 100% for local MMSChat: native Claude sessions are discoverable/readable without list transcript leakage and guarded live send/resume is validated through a disposable local tmux session.

native_discovery: Added bounded native Claude JSONL discovery under ~/.claude/projects with caps for project count, session count, and bytes scanned per file.
mmschat/list now syncs discovered native sessions into the registry so detail can open the selected session by mmschatId.
List results expose only metadata such as projectKey, cwd, title, timestamps, and counts; raw transcript text remains detail-only.
detail_read: Discovered sessions carry nativeClaudeSessionId and cwd/project metadata so existing native JSONL detail read can resolve by scan fallback and cache derived transcript snapshots locally.
guarded_live_actions: mmschat/send, mmschat/resume, and mmschat/openVisible require MMSCHAT_LIVE_ACTIONS=1 plus confirmLiveAction=true.
Default send/resume responses remain disabled when the environment or request confirmation is missing.
Live actions use injectable adapters for tests and existing tmux/visible-terminal integration for runtime; kill remains explicitly unsupported.
ios_ui: MMSChat detail decodes backend liveActions state and displays disabled/enabled live-state messaging from localization keys.
The unconditional send-disabled banner was replaced with backend-driven live guard messaging.
